study type: prospective double-blind randomized controlled clinical trial
exposure: Single 100 μg IV dose of carbetocin
Standard 30-international unit IV infusion of oxytocin during 2 h after delivery of placenta
outcome: Postpartum hemorrhage requiring additional uterotonic drugs
cohort: 220 women with a gestational age of more than 37 weeks who needed a cesarean section
finding: Carbetocin is a good alternative modality to conventional uterotonic agents such as oxytocin for the prevention of postpartum hemorrhage after cesarean sections.
